svg.aria-label: Patient pathway, from a symptom to a fix you can review: 1. symptom: Day two breaks: an upgrade, a 503, a repo nobody trusts; 2. triage: Match the symptom to the ward that treats it (triage desk); 3. diagnosis: Reproduce it: a throwaway cluster, telemetry or git (Helmbulance, MeshMedic, GitHealthCheck); 4. evidence: Commands, events, measures, or null with the reason (Markdown, JSON, SARIF); 5. treatment: A fix a person reviews: a patch or a pull request (MeshMedic, Helmbulance); 6. second opinion: Score the tools on known defects and clean twins (boards).
svg.text: From a symptom to a fix you can review
to the ward that treats it
a patch or a pull request
